name: opendeploy
description: Prepare and publish static websites with OpenDeploy.

interface.longDescription: Review a local static website, check its build and basic SEO, and publish it through OpenDeploy after you approve the address and files. Requires the ChatGPT desktop app, Node.js 22.13 or newer, an OpenDeploy account, and internet access. Server-rendered apps and databases are not supported.
capabilities: Review static website projects and builds
Publish and update approved static builds through OpenDeploy
List sites in the connected account
